title: llm-usage-metrics events export line (v1)
description: One JSONL line of llm-usage events output: a normalized usage event. Lines are not wrapped in the report envelope.

source.description: Source id the event was parsed from.

repoRoot.description: Repository root attributed to the event; omitted when unknown.

model.description: Normalized model identifier; omitted when unknown.

costUsd.description: Cost in USD; omitted when pricing is unresolved.

costMode.description: Whether the cost came from the source (explicit) or from pricing (estimated).
